checks.detail: 0 broken relative links or images found in 2,344 pages.

checks.detail: All pages preconnect to Google Fonts with display=swap; every script is type=module (deferred); no render-blocking scripts. Real LCP/CLS/INP cannot be measured locally.
checks.owner_action: After deploy, check PageSpeed Insights for the home, a repair page and the course; consider self-hosting the Lato font.

checks.name: Mobile layout at 390 px
checks.detail: 12 key pages checked with Playwright: no horizontal overflow, no stretched images (source/seo/mobile_check.py).

checks.name: HTTPS
checks.detail: No http:// links to our own site. Added Strict-Transport-Security (2 years) for all paths in vercel.json.

checks.name: URL slugs
checks.detail: 150 repair part URLs use underscores (e.g. repair/parts/air_filter/). Not renamed, as instructed. No uppercase slugs.
checks.owner_action: Optional: if you rename part ids to hyphens later, add 301 redirects in vercel.json in the same change.

checks.name: og:image and Twitter card
checks.detail: All indexable pages have og:image and twitter:card (videos/ builder fixed so a rebuild keeps them).

checks.name: Search Console verification
checks.detail: No verification value was given, so nothing was added.
checks.owner_action: In Google Search Console add the property, choose "HTML tag", and send us the content value to put in index.html as <meta name="google-site-verification" content="...">. Or upload the googleXXXX.html file Google gives you to the site root. Then submit sitemap.xml.
